identity.title: Accept raw EverRun evidence package without wrapper

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Re-run the newest EverRun evidence export produced after the exporter conformance fix directly through Ailuros evidence-audit, import-evidence-package and report --rebuild. No wrapper, no normalizer, no event rewriting. Record exact results and stop if the producer still violates the canonical package contract.
human_pressure.why_now: 8064 proved boundary logic only through a faithful wrapper. The missing proof is direct producer-to-consumer conformance.
do_not_misread: This is acceptance, not a request to weaken Ailuros validation.
Unknown is acceptable only when the source evidence genuinely lacks the fact.

machine_core.goal: Prove a new raw EverRun evidence directory is directly consumable by the existing Ailuros production package path.
red_lines: Do not modify src/** or tests/**.
Do not synthesize missing events or statuses.
Do not replace a failing sample with a cleaner one without documenting the failure first.
invariants: The tested directory is the raw evidence/ output from a post-fix EverRun run.
manifest.schema_version equals timeline.schema_version and uses ailuros.timeline.v1.
manifest.files is non-empty and names required files.
timeline is an object with schema_version, run_id and events.
Import uses the exact audited package.

observable_effect.assertion: Raw producer output reaches Ailuros report rebuild with no external transformation.

proofs.assertion: Audit succeeds with ok=true, import is created or idempotently already-present, and report rebuild completes.

failure_semantics: Package-contract failure is a producer conformance regression and keeps this pack todo.
Unknown canonical facts are recorded, not guessed.
Warnings for source-private event types are not failures by themselves.

steps.title: Locate newest post-fix EverRun evidence
details: Use a run generated after the exporter conformance implementation.
Record repo, run_id and evidence path without copying raw artifacts into this repo.

steps.title: Run direct package audit
details: Require ok=true and no structural contract errors.

steps.title: Run direct import and rebuild
details: Import the same raw package into a disposable/local db.

steps.title: Record facts and gaps
details: Record lifecycle, native/governed outcome, validation, scope, decision domains and coverage.
Classify each remaining unknown as evidence-missing, mapping-missing or consumer bug.

acceptance: No wrapper or normalizer is used.
Import and report rebuild complete on the same raw package.
Remaining unknowns are evidence-backed and classified.

must_check: The evidence came from a post-fix EverRun run.
No transformation occurred between producer and Ailuros.
reject_if: A wrapper, normalization script or payload rewrite is used.
Unknown is promoted to clean without evidence.
Raw history or generated db is committed.
The sample is silently swapped after failure.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: End-to-end direct producer acceptance; no production change is allowed.
